_why: Step 6, write path. Two measures settled in one turn, then rated one at a time. The rule that a measure is not rated twice in a row, and that each rating finds its own check-in row, only has something to bite on when there is more than one. First draft declined the log question, so nothing was ever written and the ratings were read as a rejection of the suggestions instead.
persona: Decisive. You take two things at once and get on with it.
goal: Ask what you have for winding down. Say you will do both of the first two and ask it to note them both. When it asks whether to check the situation into the log, say yes. Then say one of them helped and the other did not.

state.situation: long day, want to switch off before bed
